messages.help.retry: Retry the action. If it fails again, reopen Plate|Fold and try a different source or destination.
messages.help.source_missing: Choose the source again and confirm that it still exists and is readable.
messages.help.permission: Close any program using the file, check that you can read the source and write to the destination, or choose another folder.
messages.help.unsupported_format: Choose a DOC, DOCX, ODT, RTF, XLSX, Markdown, CSV, or TSV file, or re-save the source in one of those formats.
messages.help.invalid_ooxml: Open the document in its original office application, save a fresh DOCX or XLSX copy, and try that copy.
messages.help.resource_limit: Reduce the document, split it into smaller files, or remove unusually large images or diagrams before retrying.
messages.help.browser: Retry once. If it repeats, close browser-heavy applications and simplify unusually large diagrams or pages.
messages.help.browser_sandbox: On Ubuntu, install Plate|Fold from its .deb package, which lets the bundled Chromium keep its sandbox; LINUX-INSTALL.md, which comes with each Linux release, explains the choices. Or install Google Chrome or Chromium. Do not disable the sandbox or the system-wide AppArmor restriction.
messages.help.converter: Install LibreOffice, or open the source in its original application and save it as DOCX before retrying.
messages.help.invalid_input: Correct the source or setting named above, then retry.
messages.help.legacy_settings: Move the settings from export.toml into platefold.yml as described above, delete export.toml, then retry.
messages.error.browser_sandbox_unavailable: Chromium could not start its security sandbox, so Plate|Fold did not render. On Ubuntu 23.10 and later, AppArmor lets only applications covered by a profile create the user namespaces the sandbox needs. Install the Plate|Fold .deb package, which adds that profile (see LINUX-INSTALL.md), or install Google Chrome or Chromium and choose it as the browser. Plate|Fold never turns the sandbox off.
messages.error.converter_unavailable: No supported external converter route is available. Install LibreOffice, or re-save the file as DOCX. Pandoc can handle ODT/RTF only when its sandboxed DOCX capability check passes.
messages.error.converter_failed: No installed converter could produce a valid DOCX. Check the converter installation or re-save the source as DOCX.
messages.error.converter_timeout: External conversion exceeded the export time limit.
messages.error.converter_output_too_large: The external converter produced more output than this export permits.
messages.error.converter_output_invalid: The external converter did not produce exactly one valid, confined DOCX.
messages.error.converter_output_escaped: The external converter produced a linked or escaping DOCX, so Plate|Fold refused it.
messages.error.converter_descendant_lingered: The external converter left a descendant process holding its output open.
messages.error.converter_input_unreadable: Plate|Fold could not copy the source into the private conversion workspace.
messages.error.converter_containment_unavailable: Plate|Fold could not establish the required process-tree containment for the external converter.
messages.error.converter_format_unsupported: This file format has no supported external conversion route.

messages.advanced.title: Advanced layout
messages.advanced.inheritance: Presets are starting points. Blank fields use your document settings, then the preset defaults. Overrides stay in place when you change presets.
messages.advanced.remote_inheritance: Presets are starting points. Blank fields use preset defaults. Overrides stay in place when you change presets. Server image resolution accepts 36–600 DPI.
messages.advanced.sheet_note: Sheet dimensions are before orientation: Landscape swaps width and height. Print and Tiled print use that size for every sheet. Online can add larger plates.
messages.advanced.threshold_note: Scale thresholds choose when a whole figure moves onto a larger page. Plate scale and the custom plate cap apply only to Online. Tiled print always keeps figures at their rendered size, and tile overlap applies only there. DPI controls raster detail; it does not add detail to an image or change vector quality.
messages.advanced.exact_margins: Use exact margins on every page
messages.advanced.margin_note: Exact margins override Full, None and Bottom/right, including Online plates. Running headers and footers are omitted. Zero margins need borderless printing or trimming.
